tournamentRules.title: About this tournament
tournamentRules.intro: These are the core rules used to decide matches in this tournament.

format.bo1: Best of 1 map – the map winner wins the match.
format.bo3: Best of 3 maps – first team to win 2 maps wins the match.
format.bo5: Best of 5 maps – first team to win 3 maps wins the match.

tournamentRules.regulationWithRounds: Each map is played up to {{rounds}} rounds. The team with more rounds at the end of regulation wins the map.
tournamentRules.regulationGeneric: Each map is played for a fixed number of rounds. The team with more rounds at the end of regulation wins the map.

overtime.enabledSegments_one: Overtime: enabled with up to {{count}} overtime segment.
overtime.enabledSegments_other: Overtime: enabled with up to {{count}} overtime segments.
overtime.enabled: Overtime: enabled. Tied regulation scores will trigger overtime until one team finishes ahead.
overtime.implicitSegments_one: Overtime: enabled with up to {{count}} overtime segment (implicit).
overtime.implicitSegments_other: Overtime: enabled with up to {{count}} overtime segments (implicit).
overtime.standard: Overtime: standard settings. Tied regulation scores usually trigger overtime.

tiebreak.disabled: If regulation ends with equal scores, the match does not go to overtime. Instead, the winner is decided by total team damage across the map. If total damage is also exactly equal, the result is a true draw.
tiebreak.enabledSegments: If the score is still tied after the configured overtime segments, the winner is decided by total team damage across the map. If total damage is also tied, the result is recorded as a draw.
tiebreak.enabled: In normal play, a higher final score decides the winner. Draws are rare and only occur if both score and damage remain exactly tied.
tiebreak.effectivelyDisabled: If regulation ends with equal scores, the match does not go to overtime. The winner is decided by total team damage across the map; if damage is tied, the match is a draw.
tiebreak.implicitSegments: If the score is still tied after the configured overtime segments, the winner is decided by total team damage. If damage is tied, the result is a draw.
tiebreak.standard: In most cases, the team with the higher final score wins. Only when both score and total damage are exactly tied is the result recorded as a true draw.
